author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Parts Picking > Work Orders: same build as Trips / IHS. Dropdown removed; each work order is a row (Work Order, Type, Serial #, Customer, Status, Parts counts) grouped by year oldest first, click to expand its parts inline. Added '+ Add Part' and 'Pick List (PDF)' inside each expanded work order, a Complete Work Orders accordion, and a badge/notice on the sub-tab for work orders in Parts Sourcing. Arriving via Pick Parts on the Work Orders tab opens that work order automatically.
